description: This paper examines the physiological and metabolic changes that occur during mammalian hibernation, which is a period of inactivity and metabolic depression in response to cold or food deprivation. It outlines the roles of key hormones and metabolic processes in regulating hibernation and discusses the implications of these findings for understanding physiological responses.
